newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent trades at April +48 cts, one date kept.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent trades at April +48 cts, one date kept.

text.p: Dated Brent's recent rollercoaster ride continued on Tuesday as a cargo due to load March 6-8 traded at a premium of 48 cents to April forward paper, traders said.
Two cargoes traded on Monday at April +32 and +33 cents and a third at the equivalent of April +50 cents.
Meanwhile, the sole Brent cargo due to turn wet on Tuesday, loading March 11-13, was kept from the paper chains by trader Glencore, dealers said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of a pre-sold paper cargo deals.
